description: This is a PHP class file defining the EmailService class, which manages email configuration, composition, validation, sending, and templating within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It also includes methods for queueing email notifications based on templates and recipient roles.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling email operations including configuration, message composition, validation, sending, and notification queuing within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailDao
methods.description: Returns the EmailDao instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmailQueueService
methods.description: Returns the EmailQueueService instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getSendmailPath
methods.description: Retrieves the configured path for sendmail.

methods.name: setSendmailPath
methods.description: Sets the path for sendmail configuration.

methods.name: isConfigSet
methods.description: Checks whether email configuration has been properly set up.

methods.name: setConfigSet
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating if configuration is set.

methods.name: getEmailConfig
methods.description: Returns the current EmailConfiguration object.

methods.name: setMessageSubject
methods.description: Sets the email message subject.

methods.name: setMessageFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender address for the email.

methods.name: setMessageTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient addresses.

methods.name: setMessageBody
methods.description: Sets the email body content.

methods.name: setMessageCc
methods.description: Sets the CC recipient addresses.

methods.name: setMessageBcc
methods.description: Sets the BCC recipient addresses.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads email configuration from the database and system settings, preparing the service for operation.

methods.name: setEmailConfig
methods.description: Assigns an EmailConfiguration object to the service.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Returns the EmailConfigurationService instance.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Sets the EmailConfigurationService instance.

methods.name: getMailer
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the Mailer instance used to send emails.

methods.name: getTransport
methods.description: Constructs and returns a MailTransport object based on current email configuration.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Builds a MailMessage object with current message details, validating required fields.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends the email message via configured transporter, with validation and logging.

methods.name: sendTestEmail
methods.description: Sends a test email to verify email configuration settings.

methods.name: validateEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates that an email address is well-formed and safe.

methods.name: areRecipientAddressesValid
methods.description: Validates multiple recipient email addresses.

methods.name: logResult
methods.description: Logs informational or error results related to email processing.

methods.name: queueEmailNotifications
methods.description: Queues email notifications based on role-based templates/event data, with caching control.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateBestMatch
methods.description: Fetches the most appropriate email template for a recipient and performer role, considering localization preferences.

methods.name: queueEmailNotification
methods.description: Queues an individual email notification based on template matching and recipient roles.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads file contents from plugin directories, used for email template content.
